move.subject: Re: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
move.body:
Dear your company team,

Your sign-off suggests you would rather be at the machines than in a lengthy email exchange—we will keep this focused. We want competitive pricing on a basis that works for production. How can flexibility in delivery timing help you sharpen your price?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,000 units per year for 24 months. We have an offer at EUR 16.00 per unit (offer:DEMO-C1-0). Our should-cost estimate for this part is on record (cost:part:SH-220). Our demand forecast for this part is on record (fc:SH-220@2026-09).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 12.51 per unit, 30 days payment, 42 days lead time, DAP). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

Hallo, 42 days lead time gives us good flexibility on the machines, and the 6,000 units volume is solid. DAP adds freight costs for us, but I can drop the price to €15.30 if we agree on 14 days payment. Faster payment helps us a lot right now. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. With overtime we can deliver in 21 days, at a premium. We have free capacity for your parts. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.

Currently, our offer is a price of €15.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery DAP. As an option, we can do a price of €15.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery DAP.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH
